title: East Maui watershed plan based on ahupuaʻa
summary: As of September 18, 2026, staff are starting a watershed plan built on the ahupuaʻa, a traditional Hawaiian resource management system. The ahupuaʻa framework was proposed for the plan at the same meeting. No further details are available yet.
